g.text: u = (0.70, 0.32) m/s. The flow is uniform at
(0.60, 0.25) m/s, but one edge carries 30 % more:
the fit cannot honor all three edges at once.

g.text: The wet normals are parallel: det = 0 ≤ 1e-10 trace²,
so two components cannot be fixed. A dry edge
with nonzero flow would also give NaN.

g.text: Green arrows and numbers: edge-normal velocity Q/A (m/s, outward positive); res. is n·u − Q/A at that edge; h is the edge's flow depth (m).
Blue arrow: the fitted cell vector u (m/s), minimizing Σ A_e (n_e·u − Q_e/A_e)² with A_e = h × edge length.
